violations.description: Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Nonfood contact surface of clean in place equipment * was not cleaned properly. . Shelves and clean in place equipment (grill/fryer) dirty.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Exposed studs, joists or rafters * were not covered with smooth, nonabsorbent and easily cleanable material. . Basement is used for storage of single use items. The ceiling in the basement is unfinished with exposed rafters.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. . Floors walls and ceiling throughout requires a more thorough cleaning.
Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. . Mops not hung to drip or dry when not in use.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Window frames had dead bugs on the sill.
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (2 pts deducted)
